Summary: US-01 Submit an order through the API
Description:
As a dealer whose ERP is connected, I want to send a purchase order to Vektör from my own system, so that nobody has to re-key it and I get an order number at once.

Traces to: BR-01, BR-02, RULE-01, UC-01
Verified by: HP-05, NT-02, NT-03

Acceptance criteria:
{code:gherkin}
Scenario: A valid order is accepted
  Given my connector holds a valid access token
  When it sends POST /orders with two valid lines and a new Idempotency-Key
  Then the response is 202 Accepted within 2 seconds
  And the body carries an order number and the status RECEIVED
  And the Location header points to the new order

Scenario: The access token has expired
  Given my connector's token expired
  When it sends POST /orders
  Then the response is 401 with code UNAUTHORIZED
  And no order is stored

Scenario: The dealer is suspended
  Given my dealer account is suspended
  When my connector sends POST /orders with a valid token
  Then the response is 403 with code DEALER_SUSPENDED
{code}

Summary: US-02 Validate order requests at the boundary
Description:
As a dealer whose ERP is connected, I want to learn exactly which fields are wrong when an order is rejected, so that my connector or my staff can fix it without calling Vektör.

Traces to: BR-04, field mapping section 3, error scenarios section 3
Verified by: NT-01, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-28

Acceptance criteria:
{code:gherkin}
Scenario: Several fields are invalid
  Given an order without a delivery city and with 1.5 pieces on line 3
  When my connector submits it
  Then the response is 400 with code VALIDATION_FAILED in application/problem+json
  And errors lists FIELD_REQUIRED for deliveryAddress.city and QUANTITY_NOT_INTEGER for lines[2].quantity
  And nothing is stored

Scenario: Unknown fields are refused
  Given an order line that carries a price
  When my connector submits it
  Then the response is 400 with UNKNOWN_FIELD for lines[0].price

Scenario: Messages follow the requested language
  Given the request header Accept-Language is en
  When an invalid order is submitted
  Then detail and every field message are in English and the title stays English

Scenario: Limits are enforced
  When an order has 201 lines or a body over 256 KB
  Then the response is 400 with TOO_MANY_LINES or 413 with PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE
{code}

Summary: US-03 Protect against duplicate submissions
Description:
As a dealer whose ERP is connected, I want to retry a submission safely after a timeout, so that a network problem never creates a second order.

Traces to: BR-03, RULE-10
Verified by: NT-04, NT-05, NT-06, NT-07, NT-08, NT-14, NT-15

Acceptance criteria:
{code:gherkin}
Scenario: A retry with the same key and body
  Given an order was accepted with Idempotency-Key K
  When my connector sends the identical request again with K within 7 days
  Then the response repeats the original 202 and order number
  And only one order exists

Scenario: The same key with a different body
  When my connector reuses K for a different order
  Then the response is 422 with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED

Scenario: Two identical requests at the same moment
  When two requests with K arrive while the first is still being processed
  Then one is accepted and the other gets 409 REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS with Retry-After

Scenario: A dealer order number is reused
  Given dealer order PO-1 exists and is not rejected
  When a new request with another key uses PO-1
  Then the response is 409 with DUPLICATE_DEALER_ORDER_NO
  But if PO-1 was rejected, the new order is accepted
{code}

Summary: US-04 Run the business rules on accepted orders
Description:
As sales operations, I want every accepted order to be checked against catalogue, price list, minimum quantity, credit limit and stock, so that clean orders are approved automatically and only exceptions reach a person.

Traces to: BR-04, BR-05, RULE-02 to RULE-06
Verified by: HP-06, HP-09, HP-10, NT-09, NT-10

Acceptance criteria:
{code:gherkin}
Scenario: A clean order is approved automatically
  Given all lines are active, priced and above their minimum, with credit and stock available
  When the rules run
  Then the order becomes APPROVED by SYSTEM within 60 seconds of acceptance

Scenario: Credit limit exceeded
  Given open balance plus order total including VAT is above the dealer's credit limit
  Then the order becomes PENDING_APPROVAL with reason CREDIT_LIMIT and no stock is reserved

Scenario: Stock is not enough
  Given one line is not fully available in the dealer's shipping warehouse
  Then the order becomes PENDING_APPROVAL with reason PARTIAL_STOCK and the line is marked

Scenario: Invalid product or quantity
  Given a line references an inactive SKU, or a quantity below the minimum
  Then the order becomes REJECTED with INVALID_SKU or BELOW_MOQ
{code}

Summary: US-05 Reserve stock on approval
Description:
As the warehouse, I want stock to be reserved as soon as an order is approved, so that two dealers are never promised the same goods.

Traces to: RULE-07
Verified by: HP-07

Acceptance criteria:
{code:gherkin}
Scenario: Approval reserves stock
  Given an order for 2 units of SKU 100234 is approved
  When the reservation succeeds
  Then the order becomes ALLOCATED
  And the sellable quantity in the shipping warehouse drops by 2

Scenario: Stock disappears between approval and reservation
  When the reservation fails for a line after 3 attempts
  Then the order returns to PENDING_APPROVAL with PARTIAL_STOCK and the task is reopened
{code}

Summary: US-06 Keep orders safe when the ERP is unavailable
Description:
As the integration team, I want accepted orders to wait and be processed when the ERP is back, so that an ERP outage delays work but loses nothing.

Traces to: NFR-REL-03, NFR-REL-04, error scenarios A9, A12
Verified by: Sprint review demo

Acceptance criteria:
{code:gherkin}
Scenario: The ERP does not answer
  Given an order was accepted with 202
  When the ERP cannot be reached for the rule checks
  Then the order stays RECEIVED and the rules are retried every minute
  And the integration team is alerted after 15 minutes

Scenario: The integration database is down
  When the order cannot be stored
  Then the response is 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE with Retry-After and no 202 is ever given
{code}

Summary: US-07 Query sellable stock per warehouse
Description:
As a dealer purchaser, I want to see what can be delivered before I order, so that I stop calling sales support and my orders are not cut.

Traces to: BR-07, RULE-11, RULE-12, UC-02
Verified by: HP-04, NT-17, NT-18

Acceptance criteria:
{code:gherkin}
Scenario: Stock for several SKUs
  When my system asks GET /stock for up to 50 SKUs
  Then each known SKU shows sellable quantity per warehouse, at most 5 minutes old
  And exactly one warehouse is marked as my shipping warehouse

Scenario: Unknown SKUs do not fail the request
  When one of the SKUs does not exist
  Then that item is flagged UNKNOWN and the others are answered

Scenario: Too many SKUs
  When more than 50 SKUs are asked
  Then the response is 400 with TOO_MANY_SKUS
{code}

Summary: US-10 Rate limits per dealer
Description:
As the integration team, I want each dealer's traffic to be limited per endpoint, so that one dealer's polling cannot slow down the others.

Summary: US-12 Approve or reject an exception
Description:
As a sales representative, I want to approve or reject a pending order with a reason, so that the dealer is told at once and the decision is recorded.

{code}

Summary: US-14 Escalate overdue approvals

As the sales manager, I want approvals not decided within 4 business hours to come to me, so that no dealer waits for a representative on the road.

Summary: US-15 Map invoices to UBL-TR and validate them
Description:
As finance, I want every invoice to be produced as a valid UBL-TR document, so that the integrator never rejects our invoices for format.

Traces to: BR-08, field mapping section 6, NFR-COMP-03
Verified by: S-04

Acceptance criteria:
{code:gherkin}
Scenario: A shipped order is invoiced
  Given an order is confirmed as SHIPPED
  When the ERP creates the invoice with its ETTN
  Then the integration service produces a TEMELFATURA, SATIS document following the field mapping
  And it passes the UBL-TR 1.2 schema check before sending

Scenario: Local validation fails
  When the document fails the schema check
  Then the invoice becomes SEND_FAILED and the integration team gets the validation messages
{code}

Summary: US-16 Hold invoices for unregistered tax numbers
Description:
As sales support, I want invoices to a dealer whose tax number is not on the GİB list to be held for me, so that I correct the dealer data before the legal deadline.

Scenario: Held too long

Summary: US-17 Send invoices to the integrator and track delivery
Description:
As finance, I want invoices to be sent and followed until they reach the dealer's inbox, so that no invoice is lost or sent twice.

Traces to: BR-08, RULE-15, UC-06
Verified by: S-03, S-04, S-05, S-06, S-07, S-08

Acceptance criteria:
{code:gherkin}
Scenario: Normal delivery
  When SendInvoice returns a receipt
  Then the status is polled by ETTN every 5 minutes until DELIVERED
  And the order becomes INVOICED

Scenario: The integrator is unreachable
  When SendInvoice times out
  Then it is retried every 5 minutes with the same ETTN, never a new one
  And the integration team is alerted after 30 minutes

Scenario: A duplicate ETTN
  When the integrator answers fault 2005 for an ETTN it already holds
  Then the invoice is treated as accepted and polling continues
{code}

Summary: US-18 Notify the dealer when an invoice is delivered
Description:
As a dealer whose ERP is connected, I want to be told when an invoice reached my GİB inbox, with its ETTN and my order number, so that my system matches it to the purchase order automatically.

Acceptance criteria:

Scenario: Invoice delivered

Summary: US-19 Acknowledge an invoice match
Description:
As a dealer whose ERP is connected, I want to confirm that I booked an invoice, so that the order is closed and finance sees it matched.

Traces to: BR-14
Verified by: HP-13, HP-14, HP-15, NT-27

Acceptance criteria:
{code:gherkin}
Scenario: Acknowledge
  Given the order is INVOICED

  Then the order becomes CLOSED and a repeat returns the same result

Scenario: Too early
  Given the invoice is not yet delivered
  Then the response is 409 with INVALID_STATE

Scenario: No acknowledgement
  Then the order closes automatically 30 days after INVOICED
{code}

Summary: US-20 Deliver signed status webhooks with retries
Description:
As a dealer whose ERP is connected, I want status changes pushed to my system, so that I do not have to poll and I see changes in seconds.

Traces to: BR-06, RULE-16, NFR-SEC-03
Verified by: Sprint review demo

Acceptance criteria:
{code:gherkin}
Scenario: Status change
  When one of my orders changes status
  Then an order.status.changed event with eventId, sequence and the new status is posted to my URL within 10 seconds
  And it carries an HMAC-SHA256 signature and a timestamp

Scenario: My endpoint fails
  When my endpoint does not answer 2xx within 10 seconds
  Then the event is retried at 1, 5, 15, 60 and 240 minutes with the same eventId
  And after the last failure I appear in the daily exception report

Scenario: I answer 410 Gone
  Then retries stop at once
{code}
